segments.ja489:1.1: Mahesī surucino [rucino (sī. syā. pī.)] bhariyā, ānītā paṭhamaṃ ahaṃ;
segments.ja489:2.5: Suruciṃ atimaññittha [atimaññittho (sī. pī.), atimaññitā (?)], āvi [āviṃ (sī. pī.)] vā yadi vā raho.
segments.ja489:3.3: Musā me bhaṇamānāya, muddhā phalatu sattadhā.
segments.ja489:4.1: Bhattu mama sassu mātā, pitā cāpi ca sassuro;
segments.ja489:4.3: Te maṃ brahme vinetāro, yāva aṭṭhaṃsu jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja489:6.3: Musā me bhaṇamānāya, muddhā phalatu sattadhā.
segments.ja489:7.3: Tāsu issā vā kodho vā, nāhu mayhaṃ kudācanaṃ.
segments.ja489:8.1: Hitena tāsaṃ nandāmi, na ca me kāci appiyā;
segments.ja489:9.3: Musā me bhaṇamānāya, muddhā phalatu sattadhā.
segments.ja489:10.1: Dāse kammakare pesse [pose (syā. ka.)], ye caññe anujīvino;
segments.ja489:10.3: Pesemi [posemi (sī. syā. pī.)] sahadhammena, sadā pamuditindriyā.
segments.ja489:11.3: Musā me bhaṇamānāya, muddhā phalatu sattadhā.
segments.ja489:12.1: Samaṇe brāhmaṇe cāpi, aññe cāpi vanibbake;
segments.ja489:13.3: Musā me bhaṇamānāya, muddhā phalatu sattadhā.
segments.ja489:14.1: Cātuddasiṃ pañcaddasiṃ [pannarasiṃ (sī. pī.)], yā ca pakkhassa aṭṭhamī [aṭṭhamiṃ (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja489:14.3: Pāṭihāriyapakkhañca, aṭṭhaṅgasusamāgataṃ [aṭṭhaṅgasusamāhitaṃ (sabbattha) vi. va.129 pāḷiyā aṭṭhakathā passitabbā];
segments.ja489:15.3: Musā me bhaṇamānāya, muddhā phalatu sattadhā.
segments.ja489:16.3: Saṃvijjanti tayi bhadde, ye tvaṃ kittesi attani.
segments.ja489:17.3: Dhammarājā videhānaṃ, putto uppajjate tava [tavaṃ (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja489:18.1: Dummī [rummī (sī. pī.)] rajojalladharo, aghe vehāyasaṃ ṭhito;
segments.ja489:18.3: Manuññaṃ bhāsase vācaṃ, yaṃ mayhaṃ hadayaṅgamaṃ.
segments.ja489:19.3: Ko vāsi tvaṃ anuppatto, attānaṃ me pavedaya.
segments.ja489:21.1: Itthiyo [itthiyā (pī.)] jīvalokasmiṃ, yā hoti [honti (sī. syā.)] samacārinī [samacāriṇī (sī.)];
segments.ja489:23.1: Tvañca bhadde suciṇṇena, pubbe sucaritena ca;
segments.ja489:24.3: Devalokūpapattī ca, kittī ca idha jīvite.
segments.ja489:25.3: Esāhaṃ tidivaṃ yāmi, piyaṃ me tava dassananti.

lines: Yaṃ manti yasmiṃ kāle maṃ suruci ānayi, tato paṭṭhāya ahaṃ dasa vassasahassāni ekikāva imasmiṃ gehe vasiṃ.
Atimaññitthāti muhuttampi sammukhā vā parammukhā vā atimaññinti idaṃ atikkamitvā maññanaṃ na jānāmi na sarāmi.
Te manti sasuro ca sassu cāti te ubhopi maṃ vinetāro, tehi vinītā amhi, te me yāva jīviṃsu, tāva ovādamadaṃsu.
Nāhūti kilesaṃ nissāya issādhammo vā kodhadhammo vā mayhaṃ na bhūtapubbo.
Hitenāti yaṃ tāsaṃ hitaṃ, teneva nandāmi, ure vutthadhītaro viya tā disvā tussāmi.
Kācīti tāsu ekāpi mayhaṃ appiyā nāma natthi, sabbāpi piyakāyeva.
Anukampāmīti muducittena sabbā soḷasasahassāpi tā attānaṃ viya anukampāmi.
Sahadhammenāti nayena kāraṇena yo yaṃ kātuṃ sakkoti, taṃ tasmiṃ kamme payojemīti attho.
Pamuditindriyāti pesentī ca niccaṃ pamuditindriyāva hutvā pesemi,“are duṭṭha dāsa idaṃ nāma karohī’ti evaṃ kujjhitvā na me koci katthaci pesitapubbo.
Sadāti niccakālaṃ pañcasu sīlesu saṃvutā, tehi pihitagopitattabhāvāva homīti.

Evaṃ tassā gāthāya satenapi sahassenapi vaṇṇiyamānānaṃ guṇānaṃ pamāṇaṃ nāma natthi, tāya pannarasahi gāthāhi attano guṇānaṃ vaṇṇitakāleyeva sakko attano bahukaraṇīyatāya tassā kathaṃ avicchinditvā “pahūtā abbhutāyeva te guṇā”ti taṃ pasaṃsanto gāthādvayamāha –
Saṃvijjanti tayi bhadde, ye tvaṃ kittesi attani.
Saṃvijjantīti ye tayā vuttā, te sabbeva tayi upalabbhanti.
Uppajjateti evarūpo putto tava uppajjissati, mā cintayīti.
Sā tassa vacanaṃ sutvā somanassajātā taṃ pucchantī dve gāthā abhāsi –
Manuññaṃ bhāsase vācaṃ, yaṃ mayhaṃ hadayaṅgamaṃ.
Ko vāsi tvaṃ anuppatto, attānaṃ me pavedayā”ti.
Tattha dummīti anañjitāmaṇḍito sakko āgacchanto ramaṇīyena tāpasavesena āgato, pabbajitavesena āgatattā pana sā evamāha.
Yaṃ mayhanti yaṃ etaṃ manuññaṃ vācaṃ mayhaṃ bhāsasi, taṃ bhāsamāno tvaṃ devatānusi saggamhā idhāgato.
Isi vāsi mahiddhikoti yakkhādīsu ko vā tvaṃ asi idhānuppatto, attānaṃ me pavedaya, yathābhūtaṃ kathehīti vadati.
Sakko tassā kathento cha gāthā abhāsi –
Devalokūpapattī ca, kittī ca idha jīvite.
Esāhaṃ tidivaṃ yāmi, piyaṃ me tava dassanan”ti.
Ubhayattha kaṭaggahoti ayaṃ tava imasmiñca attabhāve anāgate ca jayaggāho.
Tesu anāgate devalokuppatti ca idha jīvite pavattamāne kitti cāti ayaṃ ubhayattha kaṭaggaho nāma.
